area: prism render service / ECS prism animation
summary: PrismRenderService.StampGrow now queues a clear of the settled grow stamp (one shared min-heap drained in the flush host's LateUpdate); before, the entity path never cleared it, so every grown prism paid exp() + 3 per-instance loads per vertex forever. PrismSway skips zero-span prisms. Resting prisms ~415 -> ~270 vertex instructions (offline SPIR-V), bit-identical.
